help: Unlocks all Domain Terraforming Initiative structures in this save; with AoTD, the Lobster Hatchery stays locked (not in games with AoTD). 'dti_unlock off' locks them again (research and the setting still apply).
Moves every running DTI project on your colonies forward by <days> days of progress, ignoring speed and shortage. A negative number moves them back.
Prints the DTI unlock state and every DTI structure on your colonies: state, condition, progress, speed and why, shortage days and the Control's AI core.
For tests: every DTI project and the Labor Camps count <count> short goods instead of the real number, from the next day. Saved with the game. 'dti_short off' goes back to the real shortage.

For tests: sets the size of every Captive Sun to <radius> (normal 25), saved with the game; 'dti_sun reset' goes back. 'dti_sun add' puts a Captive Sun next to the planet nearest your fleet; it stays in the save.
